blockingIssues.description: STT validation and error paths in `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/handlers/request-processor.ts` still return plain objects cast as `Response`, so invalid JSON/audio branches do not produce real HTTP responses.

The live ai-gateway response in `handlers/main.ts` still omits compatibility fields `stt_latency_ms`, `tts_generation_ms`, and `tts_skipped_reason`, so the pre-refactor response contract is still broken.
VAL-BE-030 still fails because `context/farm-data.ts`, `routing/router.ts`, and legacy `voice-routing.ts` remain over 500 lines.
The extracted handler modules are still not the live request path: `handlers/main.ts` keeps substantial routing logic inline and still lacks a real `farm_query` dispatch branch.
`MAX_AUDIO_BASE64_LENGTH` in `utils/audio.ts` is still too low for some exact-10MB payloads, so valid boundary-size uploads can still be rejected as `AUDIO_TOO_LARGE`.
The shared circuit breaker still counts cumulative failures because success only decrements the failure counter instead of resetting it, so Sarvam STT can still open after non-consecutive failures.

OpenAI STT empty transcripts still bubble up as generic errors instead of HTTP 400 `EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT` because the OpenAI path does not emit the `stt_empty_transcript` sentinel expected by `processStt()`.
When the Sarvam TTS circuit is open, `generateSpeech()` still falls through to OpenAI even when `providerFallbackEnabled` is false.
The TTS-specific tests still never import or execute `generateSpeech()`, so VAL-BE-014/015/016/017 remain unverified by real module tests.
The feature-specific LLM tests still do not import or execute `chatCompletion()` or `extractIntent()`, so GPT-4o-mini advisory and JSON-mode extraction behavior remain unverified.
The embeddings tests still do not import or execute `generateEmbedding()` or the real memory/RAG call sites, so the shared-embedding behavior is still not behaviorally verified.
Attendance access in `context/farm-data.ts` still only activates for literal `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, so prompts like “today” still bypass `worker_attendance` queries.
The attendance query is still not tenant-scoped when `farmId` is omitted, so it can read other tenants’ attendance rows for the same date.

Weather enrichment still trusts arbitrary `farmId` values and still falls back to hard-coded Nashik coordinates when a farm has no location, instead of skipping unauthorized or irrelevant weather context.
`decideChatRoute()` can still return `farm_query`, but `handlers/main.ts` never dispatches to `handleFarmQuery()`, so deterministic farm-query handling remains unreachable.
Legacy `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/voice-routing.ts` still exists alongside the new routing files, so the routing refactor is still duplicated and monolithic rather than fully replaced.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to describe the ai-gateway module layout as the refactor target and to note that `context/farm-data.ts`, `routing/router.ts`, `voice-routing.ts`, and inline `handlers/main.ts` logic still mean the backend is only partially modularized.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require backend tests to import and execute the real exported module under test. Constant-only or helper-only tests should not satisfy the tests-first requirement, and data-access features should include tenant-scope and error-path coverage.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-2 reviews for be-modular-structure, be-stt-provider-upgrade, be-tts-provider, and be-llm-provider all found placeholder Jest files that never exercised the provider/edge-function modules they claimed to validate.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Derive verification commands from `.factory/services.yaml` instead of prescribing `npm test -- --grep ...`, and update generated feature verification steps to match the repo’s real Jest invocation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-2 reviews for be-tts-provider, be-llm-provider, and be-routing-and-handlers again found the skill/feature metadata pointing workers to `npm test -- --grep ...` even though `.factory/services.yaml` defines the canonical test command as raw Jest with ignore patterns.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly forbid piping validator commands through `head`, `tail`, or similar helpers so workers preserve true validator exit codes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The be-routing-and-handlers review found the worker transcript again using `npm test -- --grep ... 2>&1 | head -100`, repeating the exit-code masking problem already flagged in round 1.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` to be false whenever tests-first, file-size, or other documented procedure rules were violated.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-2 reviews for be-modular-structure and be-routing-and-handlers still found handoffs marking `followedProcedure: true` despite empty `tests.added` arrays and >500-line modules.

rejectedObservations.observation: Multiple reviews separately reported placeholder backend tests that never execute real modules.
Multiple reviews separately reported `npm test -- --grep ...` mismatches with `.factory/services.yaml`.
